entries.label: Awning canvas
entries.reason: The material the cc0.awning-canvas texture set depicts. Its frame runs u along the shopfront and v down the slope, so the stripes fall the way an awning's do, and turning it a quarter would run them across the fall. It states no course, joint or unit.

entries.label: Brick, running bond
entries.reason: The material the cc0.brick-running-bond texture set depicts. Its modules are read from the set's recipe object: 24 courses and 8 units a course over the set's 1800 mm, with 10 mm joints. Its texture runs one way, so it is never turned a quarter.

entries.label: Broadleaf foliage
entries.reason: The material the cc0.broadleaf-foliage texture set depicts. Leaves the runtime draws as a cutout, so a canopy reads as leaves and sky rather than a solid shell. It states no course, joint or unit. Its texture has no direction, so a quarter turn of it reads the same.

entries.label: Carriageway asphalt
entries.reason: The material the cc0.carriageway-asphalt texture set depicts. Its modules are read from the set's recipe object: a continuous worn asphalt with no courses or joints. Its texture has no direction, so a quarter turn of it reads the same.

entries.label: Cast concrete
entries.reason: The material the cc0.cast-concrete texture set depicts. Its modules are read from the set's recipe object: 1200 by 600 mm formwork panels in stack bond, with 2 mm seams. Its texture runs one way, so it is never turned a quarter.

entries.label: Float glass
entries.reason: The material the cc0.float-glazing texture set depicts. A pane of float glass, which the runtime draws with reflection by angle and the scene behind it transmitted. It states no course, joint or unit, because glass has none. Its texture has no direction, so a quarter turn of it reads the same.

entries.label: Footway paving
entries.reason: The material the cc0.footway-paving texture set depicts. Its modules are read from the set's recipe object: 600 mm flags in stack bond, with 6 mm joints. Its texture runs one way, so it is never turned a quarter.

entries.label: Kerb stone
entries.reason: The material the cc0.kerb-stone texture set depicts. Its modules are read from the set's recipe object: 900 mm granite kerb units in one row, with 6 mm joints. Its texture runs one way, so it is never turned a quarter.

entries.label: Limestone ashlar
entries.reason: The material the cc0.limestone-ashlar texture set depicts. Its modules are read from the set's recipe object: 300 mm courses of 600 mm blocks in half bond, with 5 mm joints. Its texture runs one way, so it is never turned a quarter.

entries.label: Painted render
entries.reason: The material the cc0.painted-render texture set depicts. Its modules are read from the set's recipe object: a continuous dashed render with no courses or joints. Its texture has no direction, so a quarter turn of it reads the same.

entries.label: Painted timber
entries.reason: The material the cc0.painted-timber texture set depicts. A painted board, which a door, a shopfront frame and a stall board are made of. It states no course, joint or unit, because boards are not laid in units. Its texture runs one way, along the grain, so it is never turned a quarter.

entries.label: White road paint
entries.reason: The material the cc0.road-paint-white texture set depicts. The paint a zebra's bands and a lane's markings are made of, drawn over the carriageway rather than instead of it. Its 1000 by 250 mm extent is a stripe, so its frame decides which way the bands run and a quarter turn would lay them along the road instead of across it.

entries.label: Yellow road paint
entries.reason: The material the cc0.road-paint-yellow texture set depicts. The paint a restriction is marked in, where a white line would say something else. Its extent and frame are the white paint's, and it is never turned a quarter for the same reason.

entries.label: Storefront metal
entries.reason: The material the cc0.storefront-metal texture set depicts. Its modules are read from the set's recipe object: a brushed anodised sheet with no courses or joints. Its texture runs one way, so it is never turned a quarter.

entries.label: Tree bark
entries.reason: The material the cc0.tree-bark texture set depicts. It states no course, joint or unit: bark is not laid in units. Its texture runs one way, up the trunk, so it is never turned a quarter.

entries.label: Tree pit soil
entries.reason: The material the cc0.tree-pit-soil texture set depicts. The open ground a street tree stands in. Its 900 mm extent is one tile across the narrowest pit the grammar admits, so a pit shows no repeat of itself. It states no course, joint or unit, and its texture has no direction, so a quarter turn of it reads the same.
